changes.reason: An opt-in native scheduled Host adapter compiles only application-selected Cron metadata, validates manifest drift and delegates execution policy to TaskRunner.

kubernetes.reason: This native scheduled entry receives Workers controllers and does not provide a Kubernetes Node Host or scheduler.
constraints: Use a separately selected Node scheduler/transport; this change does not alter Node or QStash execution.

aws-lambda.reason: A Workers scheduled controller is not a Lambda event and this adapter owns no AWS invocation, scheduling or flush boundary.
constraints: Use the existing Lambda Host and an explicit scheduler integration separately.

cloudflare.reason: The native scheduled callback executes in local workerd with application DI/env isolation and common task execution outcomes.
constraints: Select an application-owned Worker-compatible durable ExecutionManager with atomic identity and attempt fencing before enabling Cron declarations.
Local tests use a synthetic in-memory execution store; no distributed durability, exactly-once effects, live Cloudflare deployment, provider certification or npm release is claimed.
UTC five-field subset only; numeric weekdays use the native 1=Sunday through 7=Saturday dialect.
Task timeout is cooperative and bounded; long work is dispatched separately.
